title: docs(readme): measured size, a second entry path, an editions table, and a Simplified-Chinese README
body:
No linked issue: a README revision the maintainer asked for directly.

## What changes

- `README.md`: the size claim is now measured and reproducible (the reference CRM in `examples/app-crm/src` is 30 files / 2,189 lines; the HotCRM sales module is 159 files / 28,456 lines), a new "Why there is less to write" section, a Quick start row for connecting an existing database, a paragraph on the ontology, and an editions table.
- `README.zh-CN.md`: a new Simplified-Chinese README with the same content.

## Why

The README stated sizes that no longer matched the repositories, offered only the "build new" entry path, and did not say what differs between the Community and Enterprise editions.

## Verification

Documentation only; no package, schema or generated artifact is touched. The line and file counts were measured with `wc -l` over the non-test `.ts` files at the commits the README names. No speed multiple is claimed.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names added)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no formatter ran; `pnpm lint` not run locally, docs-only diff)
- [ ] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. (no issue; branch is merged up to current `main`)
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset. (nothing publishes)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: generated artifacts regenerated. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
